name: popover
title: Popover
description: A panel for any content, opened from a button: the card's #262626 fill on Black, a hairline and the brand corner. It grows from its trigger and flips to the side with room.
use_for: A short form or a few settings beside the button that opens them: save to a board, a filter with two fields. Focus moves into it; Escape closes it and returns focus.
never: A list of actions: use Dropdown Menu
Content someone must read to go on: put it on the page
A shadow or a glow: the fill and the hairline set it apart
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no popover in the brand assets): the plan card's #262626 fill and corner, the neutral steps for the hairline
